messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered — gen-queue error spike (eu-central). P1. 5xx rate ~15% for generation endpoints. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/gen-queue

sanjay (on-call): on it, joining bridge. assigning devon to customer comms / status note.

devon (ops): copying initial status snippet below, pls quick checks / legal ok?

Devon (ops): ```We are investigating increased errors affecting generation requests in eu-central. Customers may see failed requests or latency. Engineers are working on mitigation; no customer data exposure identified at this time. Updates every 30 minutes.```

sarah (eng): can we avoid "no customer data exposure" until infra confirms? suggest: "no indication of data exposure so far"

maria (legal): agree with Sarah — change wording to "no indication of data exposure at this time; we will update if that changes."

devon (ops): updated snippet and add ETA line.```We are investigating increased errors affecting generation requests in eu-central. Customers may experience failed requests or elevated latency. There is no indication of customer data exposure at this time; we will update if that changes. Engineers are working on mitigation. Next update ~30 minutes.```
sanjay (on-call): l10n-anna can you do a quick localization pass for EU locales (fr,de,es)? small edits okay.
l10n-anna: on it, will return translations in ~10m.
devon (ops): quick QA — please confirm we should mention affected services list: "Text generation and streaming responses in eu-central"?

sarah (eng): yes include that, and add "temporary fallback to model-small" if rollout is happening.

devon (ops): final draft below — ready to publish after l10n ack and ops-scribe post.```Impact: Text generation and streaming responses in eu-central may fail or be slow. Mitigation: engineers applying targeted fix, temporary routing to smaller model for critical traffic. No indication of customer data exposure at this time; we will update if that changes. Next update: ~30 minutes.```

l10n-anna: translations done, minor phrasing adjusted for FR/DE/ES (sent PM).
sanjay (on-call): thanks. @ops-scribe can you post to status page & notify customers per tier? prefer staged publish (internal -> public) after sanity check.

ops-scribe: posting internal note now, will push public in 2 minutes. pinging support for canned reply.

incident-bot: statuspage update published (internal): https://status.redwood.ai/incident/2898765432 (public publish pending)

devon (ops): publishing public now.

incident-bot: statuspage update published (public). Customer notifications queued for premium customers. Will monitor for 15m and loop in if resolved or worsens. :white_check_mark:
